description: This file implements a W3C Trace Context propagator for OpenTelemetry, handling injection and extraction of trace context headers for distributed tracing.

classes.name: TraceContext
classes.description: A propagator that supports the W3C Trace Context format for distributed tracing.

methods.name: Inject
methods.description: Injects trace context from a Go context into a carrier.

methods.name: Extract
methods.description: Extracts trace context from a carrier into a new Go context.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Helper function to parse traceparent header and construct a SpanContext.

methods.name: Fields
methods.description: Returns the list of header fields used by the propagator.
